mapper.sql: ENV_SEQ, RAW_SEQ, MET_KEY, ROW_NO, TEST_S_DT, TEST_E_DT, TEMP, TEMP_PLUS, HMDT, HMDT_PLUS, BRMT, BRMT_PLUS, MEM_ID, MEM_NAME, SIGN, SIGN_URL, MIG_YN, DEL_YN, DEL_REASON, DEL_MEM_ID, INS_MEM_ID, UDT_MEM_ID
mapper.select: SELECT RAW_SEQ FROM RAW_TB WHERE RAW_SEQ = #{rawSeq} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RAW_ENV_TB ( RAW_SEQ, MET_KEY, ROW_NO, TEST_S_DT, MEM_ID, MIG_YN, DEL_YN, INS_MEM_ID, INS_DT ) VALUES ( #{rawSeq}, #{metKey}, #{rowNo}, NOW(), #{memId}, 0, 0, #{insMemId}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE RAW_ENV_TB SET TEST_E_DT = NOW(), UDT_MEM_ID = #{udtMemId}, UDT_DT = NOW() WHERE ENV_SEQ = #{envSeq} AND DEL_YN = 0 AND TEST_S_DT IS NOT NULL AND TEST_E_DT IS NULL

UPDATE RAW_ENV_TB SET TEMP = #{temp}, TEMP_PLUS = #{tempPlus}, HMDT = #{hmdt}, HMDT_PLUS = #{hmdtPlus}, BRMT = #{brmt}, BRMT_PLUS = #{brmtPlus}, MEM_NAME = #{memName}, SIGN = #{sign}, SIGN_URL = #{signUrl}, UDT_MEM_ID = #{udtMemId}, UDT_DT = NOW() WHERE ENV_SEQ = #{envSeq} AND DEL_YN = 0
UPDATE RAW_ENV_TB SET TEST_S_DT = #{testSDt}, TEST_E_DT = #{testEDt}, UDT_MEM_ID = #{udtMemId}, UDT_DT = NOW() WHERE ENV_SEQ = #{envSeq} AND DEL_YN = 0 AND TEST_E_DT IS NOT NULL
UPDATE RAW_ENV_TB SET DEL_YN = 1, DEL_REASON = #{reason}, DEL_MEM_ID = #{memId}, DEL_DT = NOW(), UDT_MEM_ID = #{memId}, UDT_DT = NOW() WHERE ENV_SEQ = #{envSeq} AND DEL_YN = 0
mapper.select: SELECT MIN(DATE(e.TEST_S_DT)) AS startDt, MAX(DATE(e.TEST_E_DT)) AS endDt FROM RAW_ENV_TB e JOIN ( SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM RAW_TB r INNER JOIN TEST_TB tt ON r.TEST_SEQ = tt.TEST_SEQ INNER JOIN TEST_ITEM_TB tit ON tt.TEST_ITEM_SEQ = tit.TEST_ITEM_SEQ WHERE r.RAW_SEQ = #{rawSeq} AND tit.TEST_STNDR_SEQ IN (7, 686, 774, 775) ) AS RE_SP ) s WHERE e.RAW_SEQ = #{rawSeq} AND e.DEL_YN = 0 AND e.TEST_S_DT IS NOT NULL AND e.TEST_E_DT IS NOT NULL AND ( e.MET_KEY = 'TEL' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM RAW_MET_TB rmt WHERE rmt.RAW_SEQ = e.RAW_SEQ AND rmt.CHECK_YN = 1 AND ( (e.MET_KEY = 'CE' AND rmt.MET_SEQ IN (0, 1)) OR (e.MET_KEY = 'RE1' AND rmt.MET_SEQ = IF(s.RE_SP = 1, 15, 4)) OR (e.MET_KEY = 'RE2' AND rmt.MET_SEQ = IF(s.RE_SP = 1, 4, 5)) OR (e.MET_KEY = 'RE3' AND s.RE_SP = 1 AND rmt.MET_SEQ = 5) OR (e.MET_KEY = 'ESD' AND rmt.MET_SEQ = 6) OR (e.MET_KEY = 'RS' AND rmt.MET_SEQ = 7) OR (e.MET_KEY = 'EFT' AND rmt.MET_SEQ = 8) OR (e.MET_KEY = 'SURGE' AND rmt.MET_SEQ = 9) OR (e.MET_KEY = 'CS' AND rmt.MET_SEQ = 10) OR (e.MET_KEY = 'MF' AND rmt.MET_SEQ = 11) OR (e.MET_KEY = 'VDIP' AND rmt.MET_SEQ = 12) OR (e.MET_KEY = 'CLK' AND rmt.MET_SEQ = 13) OR (e.MET_KEY = 'DP' AND rmt.MET_SEQ = 14) ) ) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TEST_MEMO_TB ( TEST_SEQ, MEMO, INS_MEM_ID, UDT_MEM_ID ) VALUES ( #{testSeq}, #{memo}, #{memId}, #{memId} )
